root_cause.text: In rds_message_purge(), zerocopy state was inferred from rm->m_rs being set, but a zerocopy send failure can pin pages before the message is attached to the socket, so when rm->m_rs is NULL the cleanup path incorrectly treated zerocopy pages as normal payload pages, leading to incorrect page accounting and a potential use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch captures `op_mmp_znotifier` upfront and uses it as the cleanup discriminator instead of relying on `rm->m_rs`. It adds an `else if (znotifier)` branch to handle the unqueued case by directly unpinning pages and freeing the notifier, confirming that the old code was missing this path.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a resource leak by handling the cleanup of zerocopy notifiers when the socket is missing during message purge.
intent_record.what: Extract znotifier pointer early and clear the field before checking; add an else-if branch to handle the case where znotifier exists but no socket (m_rs is NULL) by calling mm_unaccount_pinned_pages and freeing the znotifier.
intent_record.how: During rds_message_purge, if the message has a zerocopy notifier but no associated socket, the notifier is now properly accounted for (unpin pages) and freed, preventing a resource leak. The zcopy flag is set based on the local pointer after clearing, ensuring correct behavior even when socket is absent.
